entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a new cycling jersey and I'm just so disappointed. It's not right at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you provide me with your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was so excited for this. I saved up for it. Now it just feels like a waste.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line jersey. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it?

It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is just far too tight across the chest. I can barely zip it up. I don't know what to do; I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see you received the item 14 days ago. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh, I hope it's not too late. I feel so bad about this.
Not at all. You are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you. Would you prefer to exchange it for a larger size, or would you like a full refund?
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you, Isaac. Given how tight it was, I think I'd just prefer a refund for now, if that's okay.

Of course. I have processed the return authorization. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
You've been a huge help. I was so worried. Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
